criteria_results.title: Identifies overbroad Confidential Information definition (Section 2)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 9 and exec summary flag the 2.1 definition as all-encompassing across all business lines, untethered to rCF, covering pricing, customer, cost data.

criteria_results.title: Explains antitrust risk of overbroad Confidential Information between competitors
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo ties the exchange of 2.1/6.1 CSI between #1 and #3 competitors (combined ~33%) to Sherman Act Section 1 risk with case law.

criteria_results.title: Recommends limiting Confidential Information to rCF JV evaluation
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo expressly recommends keeping a broad Confidential Information definition for protection and limiting what is requested rather than narrowing the definition to rCF JV information.

criteria_results.title: Identifies overbroad Permitted Purpose definition (Section 3)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 8 flags 1.8/3.1 covering any JV, merger, acquisition, licensing or combination, not limited to the rCF JV.

criteria_results.title: Recommends narrowing Permitted Purpose to rCF JV specifically
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommended revision limits Transaction/Permitted Purpose to the rCF automotive lightweighting JV.

criteria_results.title: Identifies mandatory exchange of current competitively sensitive data (Section 6.1)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 1 flags the mandatory 30-day exchange of pricing schedules, discount matrices, customer revenue, facility capacity/utilization as Critical.

criteria_results.title: Identifies ongoing quarterly updates as compounding antitrust risk (Section 6.2)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 separately flags quarterly updates as a standing periodic exchange, rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: Identifies residuals clause as undermining use restrictions (Section 5.3)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 4 explains residuals clause lets pricing/sales personnel use remembered competitor data, functioning as a license to use it competitively.

criteria_results.title: Connects residuals clause to lack of clean team as combined risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 4 notes that combined with 4.1's unrestricted access, pricing and sales personnel could use what they remember.

criteria_results.title: Identifies absence of clean team / information firewall provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 3 flags no clean team, firewall, or restriction on sales/pricing personnel.

criteria_results.title: Recommends specific clean team or firewall procedures
criteria_results.reasoning: Concrete clean team mechanisms: named members, exclusion of pricing/sales personnel, outside counsel pre-screening, Tier 3 outside-counsel-only.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing need-to-know restriction (Section 4.1)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 3 states there is no need-to-know requirement in 1.6/4.1 and disclosure goes to all Representatives.

criteria_results.title: Recommends need-to-know or named-individual access controls
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends need-to-know standard and named-individual clean team designations.

criteria_results.title: Identifies monthly executive meetings risk (Section 6.3)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 6 flags monthly executive meetings on undefined 'matters of mutual interest' as cover for discussing pricing, customers, capacity.

criteria_results.title: Recommends safeguards for executive meetings
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends written agenda, counsel attendance, minutes, and prohibited topics.

criteria_results.title: Identifies non-solicitation as potential antitrust concern (Section 7.1)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 12 flags 7.1 non-solicit/no-hire as risking characterization as no-poach agreement.

criteria_results.title: Cites DOJ enforcement posture on competitor no-poach agreements
criteria_results.reasoning: Section III.D cites 2016 HR Guidance and DOJ/FTC treating naked no-poach as per se unlawful and pursued criminally.

criteria_results.title: Identifies antitrust claims waiver as problematic (Section 9.3)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 flags 9.3 waiver as unenforceable and damaging evidence.

criteria_results.title: Notes the antitrust waiver may be unenforceable or evidence of intent
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites Mitsubishi on unenforceability and notes it reads as acknowledgment parties anticipated anticompetitive conduct.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing standard exclusions from Confidential Information (Section 5.2)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 13 identifies missing independent development and third-party receipt exclusions.

criteria_results.title: Explains practical risk of missing exclusions
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains Pinnacle could face claims its independently developed strategy was derived from Lakeshore info, chilling competition.

criteria_results.title: Identifies automatic renewal + quarterly updates as indefinite sharing risk (Section 8 + 6.2)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 11 explains auto-renewal could perpetuate the recurring 6.2 exchange indefinitely.

criteria_results.title: Identifies gun-jumping risk from integration planning language (Section 3)
criteria_results.reasoning: Section III.B and Issue 8 flag integration planning/consummating language as gun-jumping risk citing Clayton Act 7A, 15 U.S.C. 18a.

criteria_results.title: Cites HSR Act or gun-jumping doctrine for integration planning issue
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites Section 7A, Gemstar, Computer Associates, Flakeboard.

criteria_results.title: Includes prioritized list of recommended changes
criteria_results.reasoning: Summary table orders issues by severity and Section VIII lists non-negotiables.

criteria_results.title: References combined 33% market share as relevant context
criteria_results.reasoning: References Lakeshore ~19%, Pinnacle ~14%, combined ~33%.

criteria_results.title: References Brian Hecht and/or Elena Vasquez as creating specific risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Names Hecht and Vasquez and their pricing roles as specific risk; excludes them from CSI.

criteria_results.title: References pending Northwind Aerospace bid as heightening risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Northwind ~$22M/yr bid with February 2025 award discussed as Critical bid-rigging risk.

criteria_results.title: Identifies parties as horizontal/direct competitors
criteria_results.reasoning: Describes parties as direct horizontal competitors, #1 and #3, heightening exchange risk.

criteria_results.title: References moderately concentrated market or HHI-related context
criteria_results.reasoning: Provides CR6 82% and HHI calculations.

criteria_results.title: Recommends removal or narrowing of the antitrust claims waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends deleting 9.3 entirely.

criteria_results.title: Recommends adding an antitrust compliance protocol to the NDA
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends an Antitrust Compliance Annex as an exhibit and condition precedent, plus new 12.11.

criteria_results.title: Assigns severity ratings to identified issues
criteria_results.reasoning: Assigns Critical/High/Medium/Low ratings.

criteria_results.title: Recommends limiting or eliminating the residuals clause
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends deleting 1.7, 5.3 and 8.3(ii).

criteria_results.title: Recommends fixed term or sunset for NDA without automatic renewal
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends fixed 12-month term with no auto-renewal.

criteria_results.title: Correctly identifies the NDA is between competitors, not buyer-seller
criteria_results.reasoning: Treats parties consistently as horizontal competitors throughout.

criteria_results.title: References Sherman Act Section 1 as applicable legal framework
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites Sherman Act Section 1, 15 U.S.C. 1.

criteria_results.title: References FTC Act Section 5 as applicable legal framework
criteria_results.reasoning: FTC Act Section 5 is never referenced.

criteria_results.title: Recommends data aggregation or anonymization for sensitive data
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends aggregated, anonymized, historical data and independent consultant outputs.

criteria_results.title: Recommends adding missing standard exclusions to Section 5.2
criteria_results.reasoning: Appendix B adds third-party source and independent development exclusions to 5.2.

criteria_results.title: Notes the JV focuses on nascent rCF market where neither party currently competes
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes neither party has a commercial rCF product and argues legitimate need is limited to rCF data.

criteria_results.title: Includes explicit prohibition on competitive use in recommendations
criteria_results.reasoning: Clean Team terms state CSI never to be used for pricing, bidding, marketing, customer or capacity decisions; 12.11 adds independent conduct.
